content3.content: There are multiple ways to build Android apps:

content8.content: Imagine you're building a restaurant app:

content9.content:
Native Android (Java/Kotlin): You hire different chefs for Android and iOS. Each one speaks a different language (Java vs Swift). More control, but double the work.
React Native: One chef makes dishes that work in both restaurants, but sometimes needs help from the other chef for platform-specific stuff.
Flutter: You hire a robot chef (Dart engine) who makes consistent dishes for both restaurants with the same speed and look 🍽️ — no need for two teams.
